. **STEP 0: OPEN FILES AND CREATE HHIDPN VARIABLE, SORT BY THIS VARIABLE**
. 
. cd "D:\16GBBACKUPUSB\BACKUP_USB_SEPTEMBER2014\SUMMER_STUDENT_2026\HRS_WHI_HANDLS_BMIWCDIABETES\DATA\HRS\"
D:\16GBBACKUPUSB\BACKUP_USB_SEPTEMBER2014\SUMMER_STUDENT_2026\HRS_WHI_HANDLS_BMIWCDIABETES\DATA\HRS

. 
. use randhrs1992_2020v2,clear

. 
. 
. capture drop HHID PN

. gen HHID=hhid

. gen PN=pn

. destring HHID, replace
HHID: all characters numeric; replaced as long

. destring PN, replace
PN: all characters numeric; replaced as byte

. 
. capture drop HHIDPN

. egen HHIDPN = concat(HHID PN)

. 
. destring HHIDPN, replace
HHIDPN: all characters numeric; replaced as long

. sort HHIDPN

. 
. save, replace
file randhrs1992_2020v2.dta saved

. 
. use trk2022tr_r,clear

. capture rename HHID-VERSION,lower

. save, replace
file trk2022tr_r.dta saved

. 
. capture drop HHID PN

. gen HHID=hhid

. gen PN=pn

. destring HHID, replace
HHID: all characters numeric; replaced as long

. destring PN, replace
PN: all characters numeric; replaced as byte

. 
. capture drop HHIDPN

. egen HHIDPN = concat(HHID PN)

. 
. destring HHIDPN, replace
HHIDPN: all characters numeric; replaced as long

. sort HHIDPN

. 
. save, replace
file trk2022tr_r.dta saved

. 
. **STEP 1: REDUCE RAND FILE TO RESPONDENT VARIABLE FILE****
. 
. use randhrs1992_2020v2,clear

.  
. keep HHIDPN r* inw* h*

. 
. save randhrs1992_2020v2_resp, replace
file randhrs1992_2020v2_resp.dta saved

. 
. 
. 
. **STEP 2: MERGE REDUCED RAND FILE WITH TRACKER FILE****

. use randhrs1992_2020v2_resp,clear

. merge HHIDPN using trk2022tr_r
(you are using old merge syntax; see [D] merge for new syntax)
